title: Video script prompt
promptText:
Write a 30–40 second AI avatar video script for a MahaTransco public safety briefing.

Topic: why citizens must treat transmission towers and substation fences as restricted areas.

Script requirements:
1. Opening greeting in simple English (optionally note a Marathi version can follow)
2. One clear safety message
3. Two concrete do's and one don't
4. Where to report unsafe activity near towers (use placeholder: official MahaTransco / local police channel — do not invent numbers)
5. Closing thank-you

Format the output as:
- On-screen title (max 6 words)
- Spoken script with approximate timing marks (0:00 / 0:10 / 0:20 / 0:30)
- Suggested avatar tone: calm, authoritative, non-alarmist
- Disclosure line to display: "This video uses an AI-generated presenter for public awareness."

Do not invent statistics or incident stories.
